I have one big table (where I insert the data) and a few Materialized Views based on this table. 
All was fine until recently I received an error  "Too many parts" from one of the Materialized Views. 
It turned out that the data appeared in the main big table. and in one Materialized View but did not appear in the other. So it turned out the discrepancy of the same data in the two Materialized Views.
Is it possible to reload for example only one day in Materialized View ? 
(The whole View size is more then 100 GB and included several month of data, so recreating the whole View is a too long operation.)
And also want to ask about Materialized View based on replicated table. 
I have a Replicated table on two servers and Materialized Views (non replicated merge engine) on each server. When I insert the data on one of the servers the data as expected replicate to another server but the data in the Materialized View appear only on the server where was the inset process but not appear in the Materialized View based on replica table. So is it possible to create such materialized view that can keep data from replica server (not active for inserts) ? Is it possible to do it without creating a Replicated Materialized View ?
Thanks.
